scope: Independent root review of source ranking, bounded transport, identity and callback ownership after requested fixes
checks: 4K/1080 tiers before real episode coverage; extras, empty URLs, duplicates and wrong identities cannot inflate coverage
Watermark text is a weak explicit source hint; unknown is not verified clean; no image manipulation
Known current decoded dimensions prevent an unverified nominal label downgrade
Probe ordering considers target-episode metadata and nominal hints before freshness; only probed evidence enters final ranking
Bounded workers/read sizes/redirects/deadline; public DNS and URL checks; no private addresses or executable remote configs
Failed high HLS variants can fall back to lower variants; external audio/subtitles and extensionless child keep master
HTML/JSON/empty/audio-only/iframe responses do not become playable video; media prefix is reachability evidence, not decoder proof
Recommendation copies the target episode with a single selected stream; original queue stays unchanged
First failed same-title detail does not hide the second bounded match
Cancellation, stale callback suppression, one final recommendation, live and browse-only search exclusions
